description: Convert HTML you already have to clean text / Markdown and extract its metadata and links. Same engine as web-extract, without fetching: send up to 2 MB of HTML (and an optional base URL for resolving links) and get Markdown and/or plain text, title, description, OpenGraph, headings, links and images. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
